description: Describe one data view in detail. Returns metadata (id, name, description, last_built, access, total_items) plus output_shape — the list of keys present on the first cached item, sampled so agents can compose effective query_view / get_view calls. Admin callers also receive the view's Twig definition for dev visibility. Use list_views to discover view ids first.

id.description: View id. Use list_views to discover available views.

name: describe_view

definition.description: Twig source for the view. Admin persona only — absent for public callers.

output_shape.description: Keys present on the first cached item. Empty when the view has never been built or produced no items.
